newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nam Fong IPO seen over 150X subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Nam Fong IPO seen over 150X subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering (IPO) of shares of China property concern Nam Fong International Holdings Ltd is expected to be over 150 times subscribed, market sources said at close of the public subscription on Friday.

Sources said the placement portion is seen to be about 20 times subscribed. An official announcement on the subscription results will be made on December 3 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on December 9.

Nam Fong offered 340 million new shares at HK$2.88 each, of which 272 million shares would be placed to private and institutional investors and 68 million shares would be for public subscription in Hong Kong.
Nam Fong currently holds 10 development and two investment properties and rights to manage and lease two additional properties in southern China's Guangdong province.
Nam Fong said proceeds will be used to invest in the group's development projects with the balance for working capital.
The company's properties, comprising residential and retail complexes, are located mainly in Guangzhou and other major cities in the Guangdong province.
Nam Fong said Guangdong Investment Ltd will hold about four percent of the company after the deal.
